interest: Tracks Belgium's denied request for Japanese chick sexers.
overview: 1948 telegram: Tokyo denies Belgium's request for Japanese chick sexers, since travel isn't authorized and Belgium has American chick-sexing service.

subfiles.about: Reports the rejection of a Belgian request to employ Japanese chick sexers due to travel restrictions under Allied Occupation policy.
subfiles.summary: Telegram denies Belgium's request to use Japanese chick sexers, since such travel isn't authorized under directive W-95467, noting Belgium already has American chick-sexing services.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Tokyo to Department of State on proposed use of Japanese chick sexers in Belgium
